direction.observed_defect: Northern prairie lacks natural, camera-visible relief; flat terrain with no valleys or hills, violating strategy-game legibility and architectural intent; no meaningful ground contact or terrain seams visible from reference.
direction.design_intent: Introduce one broad, asymmetrical valley with 18m radius knot, connected to existing cliff anchors via 28m radius path, creating camera-visible terrain continuity and strategic foothold without touching city pad.
direction.reason_for_new_geometry: Required to establish believable prairie relief and ground contact for strategy-game camera; existing flatness violates visual unity and composition; no new assets needed as source geometry

planned_actions.rationale: Create broad valley with 18m radius centered at [-30, 60, 0.4071593] to connect with existing cliff anchors and avoid city pad.
Connect valley to cliff center with 28m radius path, ensuring camera-visible terrain continuity and avoiding city pad.

direction.expected_visual_difference: Camera-visible valley with 18m radius and connected 28m path, creating natural prairie relief and strategic foothold without touching city pad; no purple paint or isolated mounds.
direction.mobile_risks: Low; single valley and path edits within 18-28m radius, avoiding city pad and maintaining terrain seams; no new assets or scaling required.
